title: datalakeworkspacepermission
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid, workspaceid.

appid.description: Additional application id that needs access to the workspace.

canexecute.description: Indicates whether application id has execute access to the workspace.

canread.description: Indicates whether the application id has read access to the workspace.

canwrite.description: Indicates whether application id has write access to the workspace.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

name.description: The name of the custom entity.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

statecode.description: Status of the Data Lake Workspace Permission

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Data Lake Workspace Permission

tenantid.description: AAD tenant id where the application id is registered.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

whitelistedappid.description: Application Id that is white listed in AAD tenant id to access the Graph API.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.

_workspaceid_value.description: Unique identifier of the workspace for which this permission is applicable.
